inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 10-K cash-flow add-back (ShareBasedCompensation $204M, SEC XBRL companyfacts). Cash taxes withheld on net-share settlement are not separately tagged in XBRL; instead of inventing a figure, the forward SBC charge is set at 2.0% of revenue vs the 1.58% FY2026 actual to absorb withholding taxes, which rose with the ~4x share-price move.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: 52/53-week year ending Friday nearest 30 June (FY2026 ended 2026-07-03)
inputs.share_count_basis: FY2026 10-K weighted diluted shares 383M (basic 345M + 38M incremental from awards, convertible notes and the converted Series A preferred). Year-end basic was 361M (cover page 360.5M at 2026-08-07) after preferred and partial convertible conversions; the remaining $1,060M convertible principal is classified current and is deep in the money. Principal is kept in net debt (cash settlement of principal) and only the excess conversion value is assumed to sit inside the 383M diluted count. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed, and buybacks ($2,592M FY2026, $3.26B authorization remaining) fund the flat count.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate: 10-yr UST ~4.3% + beta ~1.3 x 5% ERP = ~10.8% cost of equity; with almost no debt WACC = 10.5%, the house US hardware/tech default. Cyclicality is charged in the scenario flows and the probability weights (bear 30%), not by a WACC premium, and WACC is identical across scenarios (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP ASC 842 operating leases: lease expense ($37M) already sits inside operating costs and EBITDA, so leases are an operating cost (treatment B); the $139M operating lease liability is excluded from net debt. lease_cost_pct_path = 0.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF with mid-cycle normalization (routing row: operating company, cyclical; same treatment as BSL.AX, HAL, BAP.AX). WDC is a pure-play HDD maker since the SanDisk spin-off (2025-02-21); pre-FY2025 history consolidates Flash and is not comparable, and CSV FY2023-FY2024 rows are HDD continuing-operations restatements. NORMALIZATION: FY2026 GAAP net income of $9,424M includes a $6,498M unrealized mark-to-market gain on the retained SanDisk stake and a $545M debt-extinguishment loss from the SanDisk-share debt-for-equity exchanges; none of that is in the flows. The model starts from revenue and operating EBITDA (FY2026 GAAP operating income $4,453M + D&A $375M = EBITDA $4,828M, 37.4%; +SBC = 39.0% pre-SBC; Q4 FY2026 exit run-rate ~45.6%). EquitySecuritiesFvNi is $0 at 2026-07-03: the SanDisk stake was fully used in the exchanges, so there is no stake to add in the bridge. Owner FCF FY2026 = reported FCF 3,511 - SBC 204 = 3,307. Interest income ($51M) is NOT stripped because net cash ($527M) is well under 1x the FCF base. FY2026 cash taxes $734M (~17% of operating pre-tax) included a $627M drawdown of accrued taxes; 17% cash tax rate used throughout (Thai/Malaysian tax holidays, FDII, Pillar 2 floor). CYCLE VIEW: FY2027 is still an upcycle year (sold out for calendar 2026, Q4 FY2026 revenue $3.75B annualizes to +16% before further price rises), so year 1 is not cut; the base then assumes the historical HDD pattern reasserts itself in FY2029-FY2030 as Toshiba's capacity doubling and Seagate/WDC HAMR yield gains add exabyte supply, with mid-cycle pre-SBC EBITDA margin of 32% (historical HDD peak was ~25-30% and trough negative; 32% credits duopoly discipline and HAMR). Terminal cap multiples are scenario-specific because the bull thesis IS that the cycle has been structurally damped: 10x bear, 13x base, 16x bull. Working capital is negative capture (manufacturer: receivables + inventory > payables). The Analysis JSON guidance block is the Q3 FY2026 vintage; Q1 FY2027 guidance (issued with Q4 results in August 2026) was not in the research corpus. Replace the year-1 path once it has been read.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: long-run nearline exabyte demand net of areal-density price deflation; no historical CAGR is like-for-like
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-6.8%, FY2023-FY2026) diverges from revenue CAGR (+27.4%) by >30pp: equity was cut by the SanDisk spin-off and buybacks and then inflated by the SanDisk mark-to-market gains, so it is not a growth signal. Revenue 3yr CAGR runs trough (FY2023 HDD-only $6.3B, negative operating income) to peak (FY2026 $12.9B), so it overstates through-cycle growth. EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative FY2023/FY2024 base). 5yr CAGRs are null because FY2021-FY2022 include Flash.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC): FY2024 -1,076; FY2025 1,014; FY2026 3,307. SBC is falling as a share of revenue (2.8% FY2025 -> 1.6% FY2026), so the SBC adjustment is not eating the growth; revenue and pricing are doing it.

base.narrative: Upcycle runs through FY2028 on contracted hyperscaler demand, then a normal HDD down-leg in FY2029-FY2030 (Toshiba capacity, HAMR yield gains) takes revenue down ~12% and margins back to a 32% mid-cycle level that still credits duopoly discipline.

bull.narrative: Disciplined capacity holds: AI data retention keeps nearline exabyte demand growing faster than supply through 2029, the down-leg is a pause not a bust, and HAMR keeps WDC at cost parity with Seagate; margins settle at 38%.

bear.narrative: Hyperscaler AI capex pauses in calendar 2027 just as Toshiba's doubled capacity lands; inventory built at peak prices is digested, ASPs fall hard and WDC returns to its historical ~20-22% mid-cycle margin with QLC SSD eating the low end of nearline.

scenario_narratives.base: The AI-driven nearline shortage is real and contracted into 2028, so FY2027 grows ~28% at ~46% pre-SBC EBITDA (the Q4 FY2026 exit rate). The HDD industry has never sustained peak pricing, though: Toshiba is doubling AI-datacenter capacity by its fiscal 2027, and the HAMR ramps at both WDC and Seagate add exabytes per unit of capex. The base therefore has a normal down-leg in FY2029-FY2030 (revenue -12% peak to trough) and settles at a 32% mid-cycle margin, above anything this industry earned before 2025 because the market is now two players plus a distant third. Exit at 13x owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management is right that 'disciplined capacity' has ended boom-bust. Nearline exabyte demand keeps growing 40-50%/yr against ~30% supply growth into 2029, multi-year hyperscaler agreements lock in pricing, and HAMR (100TB by 2029) keeps cost per TB falling faster than price, so margins stay near 40% and revenue roughly triples over the decade. The market then pays a quasi-non-cyclical 16x for the cash flows.
scenario_narratives.bear: Classic storage-cycle reversal. AI capex digestion in 2027 coincides with Toshiba's new Philippine capacity and Seagate's HAMR yield improvements; the three hyperscalers that are ~45% of revenue push back on pricing, and the single-product, post-spin WDC has no flash business to offset. Revenue falls ~30% from the FY2027 peak and margins revert to ~22% (still better than the FY2023-FY2024 losses). Exit at 10x.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the valuation date sits at the peak of a historically violent cycle with record margins, ~45% revenue from three customers and no diversification after the spin. Base held at 50%. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to hold together (AI demand, Toshiba and Seagate supply restraint, HAMR execution) for five-plus years.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Mid-cycle owner-FCF valuation of a pure-play HDD duopolist at a cyclical peak. GAAP earnings are ignored because the SanDisk mark-to-market gains dominate them. The flows start from operating EBITDA, carry the upcycle through FY2027-FY2028, and normalize to a mid-cycle margin. Cyclicality is priced in the scenarios and weights, not the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Mid-cycle margin judgment: each 1pp of terminal pre-SBC EBITDA margin moves base value by roughly 3-4%; 32% is above all pre-2025 HDD history
Q1 FY2027 guidance (August 2026) not in the research corpus; year-1 path is extrapolated from the Q4 FY2026 exit rate
Convertible notes ($1,060M, deep in the money): the diluted count may understate shares by a few million if principal is equity-settled
Equity-award withholding taxes are undisclosed in XBRL and approximated by lifting forward SBC to 2.0% of revenue
Customer concentration: three hyperscalers are ~45% of revenue
